name: Temptations Under the Sun: Cyprus
overview: Based on Québec's hit unscripted series OD : tentations au soleil, Temptations Under the Sun: Cyprus turns up the heat as Canada's most daring singles face temptation, strategy, and unexpected twists under the Mediterranean sun. On the stunning island of Cyprus, singles must pair up and take on steamy challenges, wild parties, surprise arrivals, and heart-wrenching eliminations.
